messages.author: 058a9cb574edf698
messages.subject: mincov in bedgraph()
parts:
Dear Altuna,

Is there any mincov filtration in bedgraph(). I have converted meth file to bedgraph but I think it is considering mincov =10. I could not find any parameter of mincov in bedgraph()

I am attaching a screenshot from IGV where I am comparing (please look labels on left side) bedgraphs from bismark and methykit.    

Here are commands as well.

test.cpg.call= methRead("cpg_files/test.txt",sample.id="test",assembly="hg38",context="CpG")

bedgraph(sperm.cpg.call,file.name = "sperm1.bedgraph" ,col.name = "perc.meth",unmeth = FALSE, log.transform = FALSE, negative = FALSE, add.on = "")

Thanks in advance, looking for a response :)

messages.author: 058a9cb574edf698
messages.subject: Re: mincov in bedgraph()
parts:
Continuation of the first message: Sorry, forgot to mention that these methylation calls are present (< 10) in  "test.txt" but not in "test.bedgraph"

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14810" | head -n 1

chr9.14810 chr9 14810 F 6 66.67 33.33

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14821" | head -n 1

chr9.14821 chr9 14821 F 7 100.00 0.00

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14852" | head -n 1 

chr9.14852 chr9 14852 F 6 100.00 0.00

but if coverage is >= 10 there are also present in bedgraph

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14811" | head

chr9.14811 chr9 14811 R 10 60.00 40.00

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14822" | head

chr9.14822 chr9 14822 R 11 100.00 0.00

more test.txt |grep "chr9.14853" | head

chr9.14853 chr9 14853 R 13 84.62 15.38

Thanks :)

Adnan.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] mincov in bedgraph()
parts:
you can filter the methylKit object with the coverage threshold you want and then call bedgraph. you can use the [ ] notation like you would use in a data frame to filter rows based on values of a column.

Best,
Altuna
